description: Starts a randomized self-experiment on one nightly outcome (e.g. 'does no caffeine after noon change my sleep score?'). It PRE-REGISTERS the hypothesis and analysis plan and draws the whole schedule up front: each day is an intervention day, a control day, a washout day (`washout` days after each intervention day, never analysed) or unassigned (weekday not in `eligible`). Eligible days are paired in order, each pair holding one intervention and one control day in random order from a stored seed (never redrawn); a last unpaired day is dropped. Starts tomorrow unless startDate (today or later, at most 60 days ahead) says otherwise; needs 6+ intervention and 6+ control days or it is refused. One active experiment per metric. `metric` is read for the night AFTER each assigned day. Then get_experiment, log_experiment_day, and analyze_experiment after the planned end. Local file ~/.suunto-mcp/experiments.json (SUUNTO_EXPERIMENTS_PATH overrides it); no Suunto call. Not idempotent (each call starts another experiment). Demo mode keeps it in memory.

control.description: What to do on a control day, e.g. 'usual routine'.

eligible.description: Weekdays that may carry an intervention or control day (default all), e.g. ['mon','tue'].

intervention.description: What to do on an intervention day.

metric.description: Nightly outcome: sleepDurationS, sleepScore, hrv or recoveryMorning.

name.description: Short name, e.g. 'No caffeine after noon'.

washout.description: Days after each intervention day left out (default 0).

name: start_experiment
title: Start a randomized self-experiment (pre-registered, schedule drawn up front)
